parameters.content:
## CRG - Error Alert
Set as the **Error Workflow** (Settings) on Client Report Generator and CRG - Render Report PDF. n8n fires this automatically whenever either of those workflows fails a production run — no manual wiring needed inside them.

Emails the ops inbox directly with the failing node, error message, and the original run/execution ID, then logs a `failed` row via the shared CRG - Log Run sub-workflow.
